decisions.reason: Still on its own page and close to the established offer, uncertainty remains low and continuation cost is low, so the option stays open.
Only mentioned on the website suggests limited commitment, but it is close to existing lines and cheap to keep while demand is still uncertain.
The flame-retardant feature fits contract and hospitality demand, and its dedicated page signals investment, so the option remains open.
After two years with only a brief mention and building rather than close to the established offer, the option has not shown enough value to justify further resources, so it is dropped.
A new braided-structure product with its own page is still an open option, but building on the established offer leaves some uncertainty, so keep it under review.
